# technitium_dns_zone_dnssec (Resource)

Signs a primary zone with DNSSEC. Destroying it unsigns the zone. Changing a signing parameter (algorithm, curve, key sizes) re-signs with new keys, which requires updating the DS record at the parent; publish `ds_records` there. Key rollover is automatic on the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_dns_zone_dnssec" "example" {
  zone      = "example.com"
  algorithm = "ECDSA"
  curve     = "P256"
  nx_proof  = "NSEC3"
}

# Publish at the parent, e.g. with your registrar's provider.
output "ds" {
  value = [for d in technitium_dns_zone_dnssec.example.ds_records : d if d.digest_type == "SHA256"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `algorithm` (String) `ECDSA`, `EDDSA` or `RSA`.
- `zone` (String) Primary zone to sign.

### Optional

- `curve` (String) `P256` or `P384` for ECDSA; `ED25519` or `ED448` for EDDSA.
- `dnskey_ttl` (Number) TTL of the DNSKEY RRset. Set at signing; afterwards it can only be changed once every key is `Ready` or `Active`, which for a new KSK takes several hours.
- `hash_algorithm` (String) RSA only: `SHA256` or `SHA512` (or legacy `SHA1`, `MD5`).
- `ksk_key_size` (Number) RSA only: KSK size in bits.
- `nsec3_iterations` (Number) NSEC3 hash iterations (RFC 9276 recommends 0).
- `nsec3_salt_length` (Number) NSEC3 salt length in bytes (RFC 9276 recommends 0).
- `nx_proof` (String) Proof of non-existence: `NSEC` or `NSEC3`. Changed in place.
- `zsk_key_size` (Number) RSA only: ZSK size in bits.
- `zsk_rollover_days` (Number) Automatic ZSK rollover period in days; 0 disables rollover. Applied to all current ZSKs.

### Read-Only

- `ds_records` (List of Object) DS records to publish at the parent, one per KSK and digest: `key_tag`, `algorithm`, `digest_type`, `digest`, `state`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ds_records))
- `id` (String) Zone name.
- `keys` (List of Object) Private keys: `key_tag`, `key_type`, `algorithm`, `state`, `retiring`, `rollover_days`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))
- `status` (String) DNSSEC status, e.g. `SignedWithNSEC3`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <zone>[/<algorithm>[/<curve>]]
terraform import technitium_dns_zone_dnssec.example example.com/ECDSA/P256
```
